qf.ledePocketHtml: We are not here to drown you in pages. Listen first. If the frequency hits, step to the casting call below or tip on the rails - Fair Exchange, you and the Captain, no suit in the middle.
qf.ledeCastingHtml: Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is booking cast, not crowd filler. Subject line on every email: ACTIVATE THE WRONG SIDE OF TOWN: THE MUSICAL - in the body, say which lane you are reading for (shout-out, lead track, or nine-song city run).
qf.offer100Body: A named beat in the mix, voiced on the record - you are credited in the Wrong Side story, not wallpaper.
qf.offer1kBody: Your song, you center frame - written and produced here, golden-ratio mix discipline, built to open on the feed.
qf.offer10kBody: A full run for your town or your movement - cast the place in nine tracks, Sovereign Node energy.
qf.ledePassesHtml: Festival passes (GA, day, Bachstage, Golden) run on the same Fair Exchange rails. Email ACTIVATE / QUESTFEST or use the apps below.
qf.h2StudioHtml: The holographic AI behind Wrong Side of Town: The Musical is not just theory
qf.ledeStudio1Html: The show runs on phones and speakers you already own - but underneath it is a real awareness OS metaphor: honest boundaries, phi-locked structure, and thirteen channels that stay in sync with something you can inspect, not a black-box feed that vanishes when the tour leaves town.
qf.ledeStudio2Html: VALETPRU-ASIC is the name we give that layer when it stops being a slide deck and becomes operating code - a deterministic API, a phi engine, QIHOH metadata in the payload, and an RTL core you can simulate. It is the silicon-shaped mirror of the Hit Factory: same ratios, same honesty contract. On this site the main entry is Under the Hood · Juicy Juicy - Snap Omniversal Fractal Compiler (OFC). The long Digital Pru reader is deprecated but kept as archive. To run and explore the interactable stack, use FractiAI/digital-pru on GitHub.
qf.ledeStudio3Html: That changes the game for cast and listeners: big stages sell trust us. This stack says show the pipe - ride Under the Hood, clone the repo, run the tests. Fair Exchange stops being a slogan and becomes verifiable rhythm between story, silicon, and the street.

hood.h1: Talk is cheap. Open the hood.
hood.ampHtml: Talk is cheap. Look under the hood at the operational VALETPRU-ASIC - the part of the stack that runs the code you can check, not just the story on the poster.
hood.heroHtml: Big festivals run on big talk. This page is the opposite: short, plain words, then the VALETPRU-ASIC presentation on this site - how it is built and proven. To run the interactable stack, use FractiAI/digital-pru on GitHub. The document list below is optional.
hood.plainTitle: What you are actually looking at
hood.plainIntro: Anyone can say their stack is holographic or awareness-grade. This lane is for showing the work. VALETPRU-ASIC is our name for the chip-shaped discipline in the repo: rules, code, simulator runs, and logs - the same honesty you would expect before you trust a phone call or a payment rail.
hood.pass1h: The ASIC is the part you can kick
hood.pass1p: Think of VALETPRU-ASIC as the adult table for the project: not the poster art, the RTL core, tests, and evidence trail. If it does not run in the simulator or show up in the coherence notes, we do not get to call it operational here.
hood.pass2h: Start with the ASIC page, not the pile of PDFs
hood.pass2p: Open the VALETPRU-ASIC presentation first - plain tour, chip panel, bench links. That is the main read on this site. Want to interact? Go to FractiAI/digital-pru.
hood.pass3p: The numbered links are extra documents - theory, prospectus, lattice notes, the lot. You never need them to get the point. They are here when you want to read the long version on one topic.
